title: customer master
content: customer master (have customer details, current & future) - customer name, boiler_history(have or not), boiler_company (if have), customer_id, registration_date, have_insurance

title: customer holdings
content: customer holdings (customer location, current & future) - city, pincode, region, customer_id, terrain

title: property master
content: property master (customer property details, current & future) - customer_id, property_type, number of floors, rooms, have gas pipeline, external or internal electricity source (like solar or company provided), property built date

title: boiler master
content: boiler master (which customer contains boiler and of which type, current & future) - customer_id, installation date, boiler type, boiler manufacturer, model, energy rating, voltage, have insurance, last service date, fault history, boiler_id

title: installation history
content: installation history (boiler installation details, current) - customer_id, lead date, lead id, mode of conversation with customer (call, visit, email, app), appointment date, appointment happened? (yes or no), sale date, sale happened? (yes or no), installation date, installation happened? (yes or no), insurance purchased? (yes or no)

title: service history
content: service history (boiler service history, current) - customer_id, service date, service type, parts serviced

title: repair history
content: repair history (boiler repair history, current) - customer_id, repair date, repair type, parts changed, fault code, fault reason

title: visit outcome
content: visit outcome (Engineer visit outcome for service or repair, current & future) - customer_id, visit date, visit status, customer feedback

title: fault codes
content: fault codes (Fault details) - explanation related fault codes, severity, repair cost

title: parts replaced
content: parts replaced (replaced parts details, current & future) - part, replacement cost, severity, average life span

title: engineer master
content: engineer master (engineer details, current & future) - engineer name, pay_id, home_location, work_location, joining date

title: engineer availability and shifts
content: engineer availability and shifts (engineer shifts and downtimes, current) - pay_id, shift date, shift start time, shift end, lunch start, lunch end, non productive event start time, non productive event end time

title: engineer skill
content: engineer skill (engineer skill category, current & future) - pay_id, direct labour or contractor, training result, profiency, multi skill or single skill, primary skill, secondary skill

title: engineer productivity
content: engineer productivity (engineer productivity or utilization, current) - pay_id, shift date, productivity (workload hrs/available hrs * 8)

title: appointment schedule
content: appointment schedule (repair or service jobs booking schedules, current & future) - appointment date, job id, job category, severity, assigned pay_id

title: contact center interaction
content: contact center interaction (how customer contacted to book repair jobs/service jobs, current & future) - job id, job registration datetime, contact center agent id, mode of contact (call, visit, email, app)

title: product & warranty info
content: product & warranty info (boiler details, current & future) - boiler id, boiler type, energy ration, energy consumption, life span, manufacturer, imported?, warranty, addition warranty purchased? if so then end date

title: quotes and sales
content: quotes and sales (quotation offered for each leads, current) - lead id, primary qutation, secondary quotation, final quotation

title: regional demand forecast
content: regional demand forecast (forecast for repair and service jobs, future) - date, job type (service or repair), detailed category, number of jobs, jobs hours

title: regional capacity forecast
content: regional capacity forecast (forecast for engineer capacity details, future) - date, eng skill type, gross hours, non productive event, overtime, available hours

title: inventory & van stock
content: inventory & van stock (inventory details to help service and repair jobs, current & future) - location, part category, manufacturer, part type, in stock, recycled?

title: weather
content: weather (historical weather data, current & future) - pincode, date, temperature, humidity, rain, wind, solar radiation, atmospheric pressure
